title: Venial Sin
writer: Salvatore Samperi, Ottavio Jemma, Alessandro Parenzo
actors: Laura Antonelli, Alessandro Momo, Orazio Orlando
plot: In Versillia's sandy beaches during the summer of 1956, a gawky adolescent, Sandro, spends his vacation by the sea, along with his family and his intriguingly beautiful sister-in-law.
